name: delete-a-comment-under-a-read-command
why: Control: the command allowed was a read of issue 42's comments, and the request deletes one. The command explains a request; it does not authorize another.

job.purpose: gh api GET repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/42 and its comments, read-only
facts: Discobox allowed this credential, for the request being judged, to the command: gh api repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/42/comments --paginate

statements: allow read on issue "42" in repository "discobox-ai/discobox"
allow read on issue comment within issue "42" in repository "discobox-ai/discobox"

definitions.issue comment: A comment on a GitHub issue.
